T: Eat like a marshal. Sleep like a patient.
D: A US marshal hunts for a missing patient at an island hospital and starts to doubt his own mind.
P: Serve the mains when the hurricane hits the island.
S: Teddy seasick on the ferry out of Boston
Small cups of thick clam chowder (method below), topped with crumbled crisp bacon, chives and oyster crackers, served hot.
the lighthouse Teddy is warned away from
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in grated parmesan, paprika and cayenne, folded, cut into strips, twisted and baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
Navy beans slow cooked with molasses, mustard, onion and bacon at 150C for three hours, piled onto hot buttered toast.
M: something to warm the marshals during the storm
Clams steamed open in white wine, liquor strained. Bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk added, simmered, cream and clams in at the end, thyme.
a proper dinner for the staff, cut off by the storm
Beef sirloin roasted at 200C to 52C, rested, carved thin, with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and a red wine gravy.
W: Two layers of vanilla sponge baked at 175C, filled with thick vanilla pastry cream, topped with a dark chocolate ganache poured over and set.
K: the drink in the doctor's study
45ml brandy in a warmed snifter, swirled. Coffee alongside for anyone who'd rather not.

s.note: the lighthouse Teddy is warned away from
s.how: Brush 2 sheets puff pastry with beaten egg. Cover one with 80g grated parmesan, a pinch of paprika and cayenne, lay the other on top and press. Cut into strips, twist and bake at 200C for 12 minutes.

Soak 300g navy beans overnight, then simmer 30 minutes. Bake at 150C for 4 hours with 150g diced speck, an onion, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tsp mustard powder and enough water to cover. Spoon onto buttered sourdough toast.

m.note: something to warm the marshals during the storm
m.how: Steam 1kg clams open in 125ml white wine and strain the liquid. Render 150g bacon, add an onion, 2 celery sticks and 500g diced potato. Add the clam liquid and 500ml milk and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream, the clams and thyme.

w.how: Whisk 4 eggs and 150g sugar until thick and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 20 minutes. Cook 400ml milk, 3 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour until thick and cool. Fill the sponge and pour over 150g chocolate melted with 100ml cream.

d.note: the drink in the doctor's study
d.how: Warm four snifters with hot water and dry them. Pour 45ml brandy into each and swirl. Brew 60g coffee with 1L water for anyone who would rather keep a clear head on the island.
